slides.label: COVER
slides.headlinePrimary: Testing hy4-flash-free on my personal benchmark.
slides.headlineMuted: Building a CLI app from scratch.

slides.label: TIME SPLIT
slides.headlineMuted: Nearly half went to running tests.

slides.label: SAME-SETUP COMPARISON
slides.footnote: * 2 runs on OpenCode v2.2.7 (#high) — a field sample, not a universal verdict.

steps.title: The catch
steps.desc: By default, `Ctrl-C` kills the process immediatly before the summary can print.

steps.title: Model's fix
steps.desc: Configured the terminal to read `Ctrl-C` as regular input instead of an OS kill signal.

steps.title: Shutdown flow
steps.desc: Stop new requests, drain active ones, print the summary, restore the terminal.

callout.title: Test Result: 5 / 5 Passed
callout.body: Including an interrupt **50 ms after launch** — every run printed its summary and exited with code `130`.

slides.label: CASE STUDY #2 DEBUGGING
slides.headlinePrimary: Tracked down a tricky timeout bug.
slides.headlineMuted: Fixed with a single line of code.

steps.title: Symptom
steps.desc: When reusing HTTP connections, some requests kept timing out.

steps.title: Root cause
steps.desc: The model traced it on its own: updated connection state wasn't being saved back.

steps.title: The fix
steps.desc: One line changed, and all **50/50 requests** passed right away.

callout.title: Full Details on the Web
callout.body: Code snippets, request timing logs, and the exact diff are archived in the session notes.

slides.label: FIELD NOTES
slides.headlinePrimary: Passed every stage, not without rough edges.

items.head: Not the first attempt
items.text: A prevous run was stopped manually at stage 4 (**32m31s**).

items.head: Stopped 0.05s early
items.text: Finished at **4.95s** right as 50 requests completed (spec: 5.00s).

items.head: Committed a 5.02 MB crash dump
items.text: An `erl_crash.dump` file from stage 2 ended up in git history.

slides.label: TAKEAWAYS & ARCHIVE
slides.headlineMuted: Evaluating an agent isn't just pass/fail.

items.head: Don't read total tokens alone
items.text: **19.95M** is summed across 227 turns — peak context was only **157.7k**.

items.head: Test real edge cases
items.text: Things like sudden `Ctrl-C` and connection state separate strong models from average ones.

items.head: Still check git history
items.text: Green tests don't guarantee a clean repo — stray files like `erl_crash.dump` still slip in.
